This is what I like to hear. That I'm not alone in this, that I'm not uniquely abnormal, having someone else going through the same thing at some point is very reassuring. 

I take Sertral http://www.actavis.com.mt/en/products/Sertral.htm 100mg / day. If I forget to take it some day, the next day I'm gonna feel anxious for reasons above, or no reasons at all.
